answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and commit to a polynomial identity, evaluating its share for each epoch. Semaphore-style proofs bind messages to an epoch-scoped nullifier; repeating a rate-limited message with distinct content exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the private key. The verifier can then prove the violation and trigger immediate collateral slashing, while comet, oasis, and tundra remain merely labels—not identities.
